title: Breaking through the ivory tower of high-indexed journals: insights from EFL academics in private universities, East Java, Indonesia
core_idea: The study aims to assess productivity levels and identify barriers faced by EFL academics at private universities in East Java when publishing in Scopus- and Web of Science–indexed journals, and to propose strategies to improve publication success. It uses a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design: a preliminary analysis of 288 indexed publications from the SINTA database, an online survey of 167 targeted academics (165 responses), and in-depth interviews with six participants.
tldr: Assess productivity and barriers for EFL academics in East Java publishing in Scopus/WoS journals using mixed methods (SINTA analysis, survey, interviews) to inform strategies for improving publication success.
